question: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: **Every nook and cranny**

options.text: Every small corner or hidden part
Every large space or open area

solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. Every small corner or hidden part .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Every nook and cranny"** refers to searching or exploring every small corner or hidden part of a space.
 
• It is commonly used to emphasize thoroughness or meticulousness in searching or investigating.
 
• Among the options provided, **Option 1: "Every small corner or hidden part"** is the most appropriate meaning of the idiom.

Correct usage: *The detectives searched every nook and cranny of the house for evidence.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Other Related Idioms:**
 
 
• **"Leave no stone unturned":** Similar to "Every nook and cranny," it means to try every possible way or investigate thoroughly.
 
• **"Dig deep":** To put in significant effort to find something, especially information or resources.
 
 
 
• **Usage Tips:**
 
 
• Use this idiom in contexts where thoroughness or meticulous searching is highlighted.
 
• It can be applied to both physical searches (e.g., a house) or abstract searches (e.g., data or clues).
